aboutDescription: MAYO Share is a free, open‑source, offline file‑transfer app for Windows. It lets you send and receive files without internet, using your local Wi‑Fi or a hotspot. It's designed for schools, offices, and remote areas where data is expensive or unavailable.
platformsDetail: Windows (64‑bit) · macOS coming soon · Linux coming soon
author: Author
contributionsDetail: Currently a solo project. Community contributions welcome via GitHub.
translationsDetail: Managed on Weblate. Help translate into Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, and more!
licenseDetail: Licensed under GPLv3. See the LICENSE file for details.
homeHeading: What do you want to do?
homeSubtitle: Choose an action to get started

receiveFilesDesc: Accept files from another device on the same network
setupComplete: Setup complete! You are ready to use MAYO Share.
adapterNotFound: Adapter not found. Please go back and repeat the steps.
step1Instruction: Click the button below to open the Hardware Wizard. When the window opens, click the "Action" menu and select "Add legacy hardware". Then click "Next".
step1Note: The wizard will now guide you through installing the necessary loopback adapter.
step2Instruction: In the wizard, choose "Install the hardware that I manually select from a list" and click Next. Then select "Network adapters" and click Next again.
step2Note: The next screen will let you pick the specific network adapter.
step3Instruction: In the Manufacturer list, choose "Microsoft". In the Model list, choose "Microsoft KM-TEST Loopback Adapter". Click Next, then Finish to install.
step3Note: The adapter will be installed automatically once you click Finish.
step4Instruction: Click the button below to check if the adapter was installed correctly.
step4Note: You should see a green checkmark if everything is ready.
